reproducible_evidence.final_registration_rule: Run the same command at final HEAD; it dynamically scans G07_A_BASE_COMMIT through final HEAD, including this evidence file and the registration commit.

audit_finding_closures.P0_event_tail_rollback: Every non-empty log read checks an external monotonic count/hash. Complete-tail deletion, VERIFIED deletion and whole-log deletion are rejected; valid local-ahead crash recovery requires resume CAS.
audit_finding_closures.P0_write_scope_capability: Writer lease requires a platform WORKSPACE_CAPABILITY bound to principal/session, sandbox instance, exact scope and denied .git/.autonomy/.env/inbox paths. Writer report identity must match it.
audit_finding_closures.P0_arbitrary_file_read: CLI JSON input is restricted to a registered external inbox with lexical boundary, realpath, regular-file, size, symlink/junction and hardlink checks. Public key and head command use equivalent checks; production --root redirection is rejected.
audit_finding_closures.P0_binary_secret_scan: Verification reads raw changed candidate Git blobs. Text, binary, oversize and unscannable objects block mechanically; a real Git binary fixture is covered.
audit_finding_closures.P1_corrupt_lock: Stale invalid lock JSON is atomically quarantined and a replacement lock is acquired without allowing an old owner to delete a new lock.
audit_finding_closures.P1_historical_context: VERIFIED events carry immutable control-context facts and replay historical command/scope/secret-scan versions without requiring the current context hash.
audit_finding_closures.P1_complete_baseline_evidence: The executable evidence tool scans the registered G01-G06 base through invocation HEAD, not only a later implementation delta.
audit_finding_closures.P1_g06_58_reproduction: The repository command extracts the exact baseline loader/control Git objects and runs all 58 checks without checkout or unpublished window commands.

known_limitations: The production platform trust, external monotonic head and trusted receipt inbox providers remain UNAVAILABLE in G07-A. Non-empty event use and product execution therefore hard-stop until the environment registers all providers.
Self-tests use ephemeral in-memory platform/head authorities only under internal test injection; no private signing key or monotonic head is stored in the workspace.
This evidence proves the control-plane implementation only. It does not approve G07 or authorize any product Task.
